name: 46526 · Goshen, IN
findings: ZIP 46526 (Goshen) has 130 nonprofit organizations. 57 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 46 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46526 (Goshen) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
30% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46526 (Goshen) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.3 times the typical level).
